title: repo-baseline manifest
description: Schema for baseline.yaml — the source of truth listing every universal repo element.

org.description: GitHub organization slug that owns the baseline.

path.description: Location in a target repo, or null for inherited elements with no local file.

tier.description: 1 universal files, 2 governance/inherited, 3 agentic context, 4 universal-in-kind.

mechanism.description: How the element reaches a target repo.

source_of_truth.description: Where the canonical version lives (template path, pkg: spec, github> preset, org/.github:FILE, or pinned reusable-workflow ref).

applies_to.description: "all" or a list of stack archetypes.

required.description: Whether every applicable repo MUST have this element.

drift.description: Optional explicit drift rule. When omitted, check_drift derives it from tier/path. 'generate-once' = scaffolded at creation, not content-enforced.

allOf.description: Tier 2 inherited elements have no local file.
